resources.string: Dictate into the field you are typing in, with Gboard staying up: hold volume-down or tap the accessibility button, speak, and stop. voxdroid reads the window in front when you start and when the text arrives, to find the field and put the text there. It also receives every hardware key press (acting on volume-down only), reads where the keyboard window is to place the pill, reads the language of the keyboard, and checks the audio mode when you start, to refuse a take during a call.
A hold starts dictation, a press stops it. While on, holding volume-down no longer lowers the volume continuously.
A tap starts and stops dictation.
While off, a take is refused during a call.
A click when dictation starts and when its text lands, a double click when it fails. Follows Android\'s Touch feedback setting.
No text field, or the field changed
field changed — copied to the clipboard
The base URL of your whisper endpoint. voxdroid appends /audio/transcriptions itself.
Bearer token, optional. Leave it empty when the server needs none.
Sent as the model field. A self-hosted whisper.cpp ignores it; a hosted API needs a name.
Terms to spell your way, sent as the whisper prompt and folded into the cleanup prompt. One line or many.
The whole request. Connecting is always given 5 seconds of it.
A dictation scoring above this is dropped as silence. 0 turns the gate off, and with it routing an auto take to a lane.
Two-letter ISO language codes, comma separated. Each one gets a row below, which opens its own page.

An endpoint of its own for %1$s, typically a fine-tune. Empty sends %1$s to the STT endpoint above. With the no-speech gate on, auto asks the STT endpoint first and sends the take on to this lane when it hears %1$s at 0.5 or more.
Send the STT token to the %1$s lane
The STT token goes to this lane.
No token goes to this lane.
This lane\'s own token goes to it instead.
Bearer token for the %1$s lane only, instead of the STT token. Empty sends it none unless the switch above asks for the STT token.
Punctuation, fillers and the glossary, between the transcript and the cursor. An empty endpoint or model leaves it off.
The base URL of your chat endpoint. voxdroid appends /chat/completions itself.
Sent as the model field. Empty leaves the cleanup pass off, exactly as an empty endpoint does.
A transcript shorter than this is typed as it came. 0 cleans up everything.
Off lower-cases the first word instead, leaving I, proper nouns and acronyms alone.
Exactly one trailing . comes off what is typed; an ellipsis, ? and ! survive.
Plain http: your audio, transcript and token cross the network in clear — fine over Tailscale or WireGuard, not over anything else.
Blocked: plain http is off. Use https://, or turn on Allow insecure (http) endpoints on the Speech page.
Off refuses plain http:// to anything but this phone: STT, cleanup and every lane.
Over plain http://, your audio, glossary, transcript and bearer tokens cross the network unencrypted. This is safe only over a network that encrypts by itself, such as Tailscale or WireGuard.
Not an http(s) URL. An endpoint starts with http:// or https://.
Plain http:// is off. Use https://, or turn on Allow insecure (http) endpoints on the Speech page.
The port is a number from 1 to 65535.
voxdroid appends %1$s itself. Give the base URL without it.
A number written with a dot, like 0.3 or 30.
A whole number, zero or more.
No text field, or the field changed
The cleanup pass and its endpoint
No browser found. The privacy policy is at %1$s
service off — turn on voxdroid in Accessibility settings
plain http is off: use https:// or turn on Allow insecure (http) endpoints
endpoint unreachable — check the URL and the network
unreachable — check the URL and the network
Hold volume-down or tap the accessibility button, speak, stop
